response.rationale: “Menghitung” is the ordinary Indonesian form for determining the number of items, while Malaysian Malay commonly prefers “mengira” for the same sense. The distinction is useful without implying exclusive ownership.
response.risk_rationale: “Menghitung” is also understandable and used in Malaysian Malay, so register or context can soften the preference.
response.shared_synonym_rationale: Malaysian Malay also uses “menghitung,” especially in more formal or calculation-oriented contexts, but “mengira” remains a credible everyday preference; Indonesian “mengira” more commonly means estimate or guess.
